extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the BZT52C10S row was selected from the BZT52C2V0S through BZT52C75S table.
The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as 8d99c0b95ddbd62581320fd03378a72d97d914bc201c735536cd50e5f6753113.
Zener reverse semantics are preserved: nominal VZ = 10.0 V is paired with the tabulated reverse test current IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT = 20 ohm is at IZT and maximum ZZK = 150 ohm is at IZK = 1 mA.

The BZT52C10S electrical-characteristics row gives inclusive VZ bounds of 9.4 V minimum and 10.6 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA, maximum reverse leakage IR = 0.2 microA at VR = 7.0 V, and admissible IZM = 5 mA, all at Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.

The five zener-characteristic points are direct approximate graph-read observations from the visible BZT52C10S trace labeled 10 in p. 3 Fig. 1 at labeled logarithmic-current grid values; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no points were interpolated.
Maximum ratings include PD = 200 mW and forward voltage VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA on p. 1; junction and storage temperature limits are -55 to +150 degC and typical RthetaJ-A is 417 degC/W.

No component-specific capacitance or reverse-recovery-time specification is published in the supplied datasheet. The p. 3 capacitance and dynamic-impedance plots are family-level typical characteristics without a uniquely identified BZT52C10S trace and were not assigned component-specific points.
